svg.text: McCzarny recently made several updates across
his GitHub projects. In chromium-daily-digest,
he implemented a fallback LLM provider,
allowing the system to switch to OpenCode if
the primary AI fails, thereby improving
reliability. He also refined the configuration
by expanding focus areas and correcting LLM
context limits. To optimize resource usage, he
adjusted cron schedules for daily digests and
temporarily disabled scheduled summary
generation. For opencode-sessions, he
introduced a "Go usage" key to the Stream Deck
plugin, enabling users to monitor their
OpenCode Go consumption. He also enhanced
session status detection, ensuring that
sessions awaiting user input are correctly
marked. Furthermore, he undertook a significant
overhaul of the build system, migrating it from
Rollup to esbuild for improved performance.
This included updating multiple development
dependencies and resolving compatibility issues
with TypeScript.
